messages:
Maya R: Heads up — small satellite account 'Flora Labs' usage dropped ~45% this week. Looks like only one active user left. starting churn runway ~30d.
Jamal C: thanks Maya. which feature usage fell? can we confirm billing/seat changes first? :thinking_face:
Maya R: embeddings and batch inference calls are almost nil; they still have 3 seats but only 1 token-ing yesterday. billing looks unchanged for the month so far.
Priya S: noted. last onboarding call included the pipeline template; they said they'd integrate but never shared logs. recommend a lightweight poke + offer a 30m troubleshooting session.
Alex G: agree. propose short play: 1) 1:1 nudge email + invite to office hours 2) quick health check runbook 3) downgrade-avoidance offer (free troubleshooting hours) 4) if no response in 7d, schedule retention call.
Maya R: draft nudge msg in thread below — can someone vet? "Hey Flora team — noticed usage dipped. We can run a diagnostic and help unblock integration in 30 mins. Free of charge. Book: <https://cal.com/redwood/office-hours>". keep it light.
Jamal C: tweak: add one concrete hint to catch attention. e.g., "If you see errors like `kv cache mismatches` or slow cold starts, bring logs and we'll debug live." otherwise looks good.
Priya S: I can prepare a 15-min triage script / checklist. will drop snippet:
```
Flora triage checklist:
- Confirm model + quantization variant
- Check request pattern: batch sizes, seq len
- Look for <500ms tail lat spikes
- Search logs for "auth/timeout" or "missing kv"
- Re-run sample payload locally w/ sdk v0.9
```
Alex G: love that. also add a one-click rollback note: "If regression suspected, propose change to previous pinned model for 24h while we investigate." reduces fear of experimentation.
CS Bot: Reminder: create a "satellite-nudge" play tag in Gainsight and assign to Maya R with 7d follow-up. :robot_face:
Maya R: I'll send the nudge today 9am PT. Priya, can you join the first session if they accept? Jamal will prepare the account health dashboard snapshot.
Priya S: yes, I can join. I'll upload the triage doc to the shared playbook folder and paste link after.
Jamal C: dashboard snapshot link: https://redwood-notes/internal/flora/dashboard-1739998080
Maya R: sent nudge (copy below). if no reply by Mon EOD we'll escalate to renewal owner for targeted offer. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
Maya R: "Hi Flora team — quick note from Redwood: we noticed activity dropped and wanted to offer a free 30-minute troubleshooting session to get your integration back to production. If you're seeing errors like `kv cache mismatch` or cold-start latency, bring logs and we'll pair with you. Book: https://cal.com/redwood/office-hours — Maya, CSM"
Alex G: small ask — track the outcome as: responded / accepted + fixed / accepted + escalated / no response. keeps metrics clean.
Maya R: will update thread after 7d. putting this on my weekly radar.
